# Burger Point

> Best fast food restaurant in Jankipuram, Lucknow. Burgers, momos, indo-chinese, pizza, pasta, shakes and more. Dine-in, takeaway and home delivery. 100% vegetarian.

## About

Burger Point is a fast food restaurant located in Jankipuram, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. Popular among students of BBAU, Lucknow University Jankipuram campus, and City Group of Colleges.

- Address: 60 Feet Road, Jankipuram, Lucknow, UP 226021
- Phone: +91-9194008822
- Hours: Monday–Sunday 11:00 AM – 10:30 PM
- Cuisines: Burgers, Momos, Indo-Chinese, Pizza, Pasta, Milkshakes

## Ordering & Menu

- [Order Online / Full Menu](https://www.burgerpoint.co.in/)
- [Dine-In](https://www.burgerpoint.co.in/#dine): Scan table QR code or enter table number
- [Takeaway](https://www.burgerpoint.co.in/#takeaway): Enter name and phone number
- [Delivery](https://www.burgerpoint.co.in/#delivery): Available within 5 km of Jankipuram
- [Book a Table](https://www.burgerpoint.co.in/#reservation)

## Menu Highlights

- Burgers: Smash Burger, Crispy Chicken Burger, Double Patty, Zinger, Veg Aloo Tikki Burger
- Momos: Steamed, Fried, Pan-Fried, Kurkure
- Indo-Chinese: Veg/Chicken Chowmein, Schezwan Noodles, Manchurian, Fried Rice
- Pizza: Margherita, Chicken Pizza
- Pasta: Arrabbiata, Cheesy White Sauce
- Sides: Loaded Cheese Fries, Peri Peri Fries, Spring Rolls
- Drinks: Chocolate Shake, Oreo Shake, Cold Coffee, Mocktails
